adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the call `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)` passes `credentialId` as the third argument. But `refreshOAuthTokens` treats that third argument as a Cal.com *userId* and sends it as `calcomUserId` in the sync request (`body: new URLSearchParams({ calcomUserId: userId.toString(), appSlug })`). Every other updated call site passes `credential.userId`, not a credential identifier. This inconsistency means the sync endpoint will receive a credential-row id (or at least a non-user id) where it expects a user id, breaking token refresh/sync for Zoho Bigin under credential sharing.
